answer: Rate-limiting nullifiers bind each identity to one unspent nullifier derived from a locked stake. An attacker must acquire 2,400 stake deposits because every sybil needs its own nullifier to pass the gate; duplicates are rejected across epochs. The network enforces this via on-chain nullifier non-membership checks. The shale registry anchors enrollment, the quartz attestation log records each proof, and the onyx checkpoint finalizes penalties.
